capture_confirm: Confirm this frame for shot coverage
capture_confirmed: Frame confirmed; coverage depends on quality and required people
capture_delayed: Delayed assessment: this report is older than 30 seconds.
capture_revoked: The current shot list is unavailable because consent was revoked. You can explicitly replace it with a new list.
capture_save_error: Unable to save shot list. Retry with the same edits.
capture_confirm_error: Unable to confirm this frame. Check consent and report availability, then retry.
capture_ack_error: Unable to acknowledge alert. Refresh the session before retrying.
capture_state_error: Unable to change session state. Retry, or refresh if the revision changed.
capture_conflict: Another participant changed the shot list. Your draft has been retained.
capture_conflict_load_error: Unable to load the changed shot list. Your draft has been retained; retry saving to compare.
capture_conflict_choice: Compare the shared list with your draft above. Keeping your draft allows a later explicit save to replace the shared list.
capture_use_server: Use shared list and discard my draft
capture_keep_draft: Keep my draft for the next save
capture_draft_storage_error: Unable to save the draft on this device. Keep this screen open until the shared list is saved.
capture_access_denied: Access to this session is no longer available. Local session drafts have been cleared.
capture_create_description: Reuse the grouping and Capture checks of an existing session. The server revalidates its calibrations.
capture_no_collections: Create a collection in the project first.
capture_no_template: A qualified Capture session must first be configured by the operator.
capture_template_unavailable: This session has no available Capture policy. Choose another.
capture_create_error: Unable to create the session. Retry with the same selections or check project qualification.
editor_conflict_help: Compare both versions. Keeping local edits prepares a new save; nothing is overwritten automatically.
editor_conflict_keep_local: Keep local edits for next save
editor_conflict_source_changed: The source changed. Open the current asset version before resolving.
editor_cache_failed: Local draft could not be stored. Keep this editor open until your changes are saved.
compare_unavailable: Comparison unavailable. Check preview readiness and select the frames again.
compare_local_decisions: Comparison decisions currently stay on this screen.
scene_reference_select: Use frame as reference in a new analysis
scene_load_failed: Unable to load this analysis. Check access and analysis readiness.
scene_reference_failed: The analysis request did not complete. Retry the same request.
scene_reference_conflict: The analysis selection or session changed. Reload before selecting a reference again.
scene_reference_unavailable: Analysis service unavailable. Retry the same request when available.
scene_access_denied: Access to this analysis is no longer available.
session_load_failed: Unable to load the session or analyses.
session_policy_failed: Policy was not saved. Check values or reload after a conflict.
session_policy_resolve: Save local grouping using the current revision
layers_invalid: Layer change rejected. Check source, mask canvas and geometry order.
layers_load_failed: Unable to load layers. Check the V2 draft, source version and unsaved changes.
layers_local_only: V2 layers are saved separately. The current legacy preview does not display them.
layers_saved: The submitted V2 layers were saved.
layers_saved_refresh: Layers were saved, but their document could not be verified. Reload V2 layers before saving again.
layers_save_reload: The V2 revision or access changed. Reload V2 layers before saving.
layers_save_retry: The save result is unknown. Retry the same request.
